Priya (PM): ok team — planning rollout plan for the new regional fallback policy + phased beta for routing. want a concrete ladder we can hand to sales/support.
Alex (Eng): 👍 can you summarize the goals? latency SLOs, cost targets, safety gates?
Priya (PM): goal = expose canary to 5% first, measure p50/p95/p99 + cost delta, fail closed to current stable model if errors spike. also run A/B on reranking variant in eu-west only.
Mira (SRE): propose metrics: error_rate > 0.5% OR p99 > 2x baseline for 5m -> automatic rollback. also circuit-breaker if queue-depth > 200 for 2m.
Jorge (Data): for A/B need pre-seeded prompt sets for quality — I can provide 3 signal sets (safety, latency-sensitive, long-context). we'll track hallucination rate using our eval hook.
Sam (QA): i'll run regression suite in shadow for 24h prior to canary, will share quick report template. any special test flows?
Priya (PM): include tenant-sensitive flows and payment-related prompts. we need a customer opt-in list for the first 5% — sales has a few.
Alex (Eng): rollout ladder idea: 1) shadow for 24h (0% traffic), 2) 5% canary in 1 region (eu-west), 3) 20% regional ramp (eu + na), 4) 50% global, 5) full. each step gated by telemetry checks.
Mira (SRE): add cooldown windows between ramps: min 30m, unless metrics look perfect for 2h. will add automated alerting to the console dashboard.
Priya (PM): fallback policy: if model variant causes latency/cost to exceed configured budget, route to lighter quantized variant v2 or fallback to stable model. prefer model variant fallback rather than full kill unless error rage.
Alex (Eng): implementation detail: feature flag hierarchy -> tenant override > region flag > global flag. flags must support gradual percentage and sticky user assignment.
Sam (QA): please add deterministic sticky seeding in the flag logic so A/B identities remain consistent across retries. avoids flakey analytics.
Jorge (Data): for A/B we'll run Bayesian lift tests on quality metrics and token-cost-per-request, threshold for promotion: posterior > 0.95 for quality and no >10% cost uplift.
Priya (PM): decision window: aim to finish canary evaluation within 48h of first traffic. if metrics inconclusive, hold and consult product.
Mira (SRE): add emergency kill-switch runbook: /runbook rollback -> deploy-bot will cut traffic to stable model within 60s, engineers oncall paged.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: shadow -> canary start at 1755557920 (ETA automated).
Alex (Eng): tickets: feature-flag impl (ENG-1456), canary metrics dashboard (ENG-1457), rollback runbook update (SRE-980). assign me ENG-1456/1457.
Priya (PM): owners noted. next steps: Jorge to provide eval sets by EOD, Sam to finalize regression checklist, Mira to add SLO alerts, Alex to land flags + QA hooks. we'll sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar:
Mira (SRE): one more — add header propagation so we can trace user->model routing in logs. tiny change but very helpful for triage.
Priya (PM): perfect. thanks all. I'll draft the customer communication and post rollout checklist after we have the dashboards ready. :thumbsup:
